theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_sa_smoothed_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (δ σ : ℝ) (ρ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (s : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), 0 < σ → σ < δ → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) → ∫ z, ρ z = 1 → support ρ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) σ → AEStronglyMeasurable s volume → (∀ x, ‖s x‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ x, x ∉ {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ} → s x = 0) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (convolution ρ s (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) ∧ HasCompactSupport (convolution ρ s (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) ∧ tsupport (convolution ρ s (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} ∧ ∀ y, ‖convolution ρ s (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume y‖ ≤ 1
